items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: I told them fellas get Juddy right behind y'all they oughta be here in about a half an hour.

ctx.x: I said, I'm kind of on that sand to keep that now. I said, the best thing you can do.

I said, that's a nice fella. You know, I worked with Harry for years. I said, and Ellick was kind of scared. He said, well, before you get mad and I'm way up here, don't bring me home. I said, I'm the one that look out for you. Your daddy told me to look out for you. I said, you're not going with them fellas. And he fooled on. He said, well, you think I ought to tell Harry? I said, that's the thing you should do. Tell him. Tell him what them fellas is fixing to do. And I said, he said, well, I took $35 from him.…
Oh yeah, I heard about him.
